releaseNotes:
• Fix: Blur overlay no longer blinks or flickers — short-circuits redundant redraws and tightens box sizing.
• Fix: Males no longer falsely blurred in Female-Only mode — tightened cross-gender NMS, added confidence-margin checks, gender-aware cluster seeding and body-part assignment.
• Fix: Internet now works in all browsers — VPN sends TCP RST for DoT/TCP-DNS probes, binds upstream DNS to physical network, adds DoH fallback and DNS caching.
